head.intro: Who may do both steps of a stock decision, where goods go when nobody names a place, which adjustments wait for a yes, and how far back a move may be dated.

live.changedBody: Your changes on this page are kept until you read again; saving now may be refused because the rules moved on.

scope.label: Whose rules
scope.companyHint: The warehouse rules of {company}. Where it keeps none of its own, it follows every company’s.
scope.allHint: The warehouse rules every company follows where it keeps none of its own.

noAccess.title: Warehouse rules are not in your role
noAccess.body: Reading them needs the right to see stock (inventory.stock.view). An administrator gives it in Admin › Roles & permissions.

reason.label: Why
reason.hint: This widens what one person can do: say why (kept in the audit log). Saving then asks for a fresh code.

sod.title: Separation of duties
sod.description: Two steps of one stock decision are never done by the same person.
sod.failed: The separation rules could not be read
sod.locked: Nobody approves their own request, the Owner included.

COUNTER_NOT_APPROVER.title: Who counted does not approve the count
COUNTER_NOT_APPROVER.on: Who counted, recounted or scanned a line that differs never approves the count; a recount is another person’s.
COUNTER_NOT_APPROVER.off: Off: one person may count, recount and approve the same differences.

RECEIVER_NOT_MATCHER.title: Who received the goods does not approve their invoice
RECEIVER_NOT_MATCHER.on: Who received the goods never approves their supplier invoice nor accepts a difference of its match.
RECEIVER_NOT_MATCHER.off: Off: the person who received the goods may approve their invoice.

sod.loosens_one: Switching this rule off lets one person do both steps: Save asks why, then a fresh code.
sod.loosens_other: Switching these {count} rules off lets one person do both steps: Save asks why, then a fresh code.
sod.reasonHint: Say why one person may now do both steps (kept with the rule while it is off, and in the audit log).
sod.noteDefault: Both rules are on by default. Switching one on again never asks for a code.
sod.noteWorkers: A floor worker counts as the office user they are: scanning on the floor and approving in the office are the same person.

posting.title: Posting dates
posting.description: How far back a move may be dated. Closed months come from Finance.
posting.failed: The posting-date rule could not be read
posting.daysHint: {min} (the same day only) to {max} days before the day a move is entered.
posting.noneHint: No limit: a move may be dated any earlier day, except in a closed month.
posting.window: Today, {today}, a move may be dated back to {earliest}.
posting.windowOpen: Today, {today}, a move may be dated any earlier day outside a closed month.
posting.loosens: More days back, or no limit, widens what one person can do: Save asks why, then a fresh code.
posting.closed: A closed month refuses a date inside it, whatever this says. Months are closed in Finance:
posting.floor: A move made on the floor always counts on the day it is entered.
posting.future: No move is dated after today.

adjust.title: Adjustment approval
adjust.description: Stock adjustments worth more than a value wait for a yes.
adjust.failed: The adjustment rule could not be read
adjust.valueHint: In {currency}, valued at the stock’s cost.
adjust.valueHintAll: In each company’s own currency, valued at the stock’s cost.
adjust.noneHint: No value: no adjustment waits for a yes.

state.NO_VALUE: No value is set: every adjustment posts at once, without a yes.
state.NO_RULE: A value is set, but no approval rule for stock adjustments is switched on: adjustments above it post without a yes until the Owner switches one on.
state.WAITS_one: Adjustments above the value wait for a yes: {count} approval rule is switched on.
state.WAITS_other: Adjustments above the value wait for a yes: {count} approval rules are switched on.
state.UNKNOWN: Whether adjustments wait is not known yet.

adjust.loosens: A higher value, or none, lets more adjustments post without a yes: Save asks why, then a fresh code.
adjust.onlyAdjust: Only an adjustment made by hand waits. Counts, lot splits and transfers post as they always did.
adjust.unknownValue: An adjustment whose value nobody can tell (no cost, another currency) waits too.
adjust.rulesFailed: The approval rules could not be read

empty.title: No approval rule for stock adjustments
empty.body: Who approves an adjustment is an approval rule’s. Write one in Admin › Approvals, automation & AI; it starts switched off.

adjust.firstDecides: The first rule switched on whose approver is not the person asking decides.
adjust.noneByDefault: No approval rule is switched on by default: only the Owner switches one on.

alerts.title: Low-stock alerts
alerts.on: On: a material below its minimum raises an alert.
alerts.off: Off: no low-stock alert is raised.

defaults.title: Default locations
defaults.description: Where goods go when nobody names a place: per site, per kind of material and per purpose.
defaults.failed: The default locations could not be read

noSite.title: No site yet
noSite.body: Default locations are kept per site. Add a site and its places in Warehouse › Locations first.

defaults.noteOrder: A command takes the kind’s own place, else the first row’s place when it may hold the goods, else its own rule.
defaults.noteKinds: Only places that may serve the purpose are offered: a quality place is a quarantine shelf, finished garments go only where they may lie.
defaults.notePlaces: The places themselves are kept in
defaults.everyKindHint: Every kind without a row of its own

ownRule.RECEIVING: None: the receipt asks for the goods-in place
ownRule.QUALITY: None: the hold names its quarantine place
ownRule.ISSUE: None: the pick names its place
ownRule.RETURN: None: the return names its place
ownRule.PUT_AWAY: None: the move names its place

defaults.archivedPlace: This place is archived: choose another.
defaults.noneServes: No active place on this site may serve this (it takes: {kinds}).
defaults.caption: Default places of site {site}

crvi.title: Cr VI evidence rule
crvi.description: Which evidence counts for the hexavalent chromium of a leather lot. It is kept in Compliance, not here.
crvi.failed: The Cr VI evidence rule could not be read

rule.SUPPLIER_REPORT_ACCEPTED: A supplier report covering the article and period

crvi.why: Receipts and lots use it to decide whether a leather lot may be released.
crvi.link: Change it in Compliance › Rules & markets

held.noRight: Changing the warehouse rules needs inventory.rules.manage over this company (warehouse, finance, the Owner).
held.noRightAll: Every company’s warehouse rules are changed only by a role over every company.
held.offline: Offline: changes are kept on this page until the connection is back.
held.offlineBody: This is the last copy read. Nothing can be saved until the connection is back.
held.noApprovalsView: Reading the approval rules needs the right to see approvals (approvals.view).
held.noRulesManage: Writing approval rules needs the right to keep them (approvals.rules.manage): the Owner or an administrator.
held.noCost: The value is a cost: it is shown and changed only with the right to see costs (money.cost).
held.noLocationsView: Default locations need the right to see locations (inventory.locations.view).
held.noCrViView: Reading this rule needs the right to see lots and their tests (quality.lots.view).

problem.reasonNeeded: Say why: this widens what one person can do.
problem.amountRange: The value is 0 or more, and not that large.

read.signed_out: Your session ended: sign in again.
read.forbidden: Your role does not reach these rules.
read.unavailable: The server could not be reached. Try again.
read.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment and try again.
read.contract: The server answered something this page does not understand. Try again later.
read.internal: Something went wrong reading this. Try again.

write.moved: Someone changed these rules meanwhile: read again (nothing was overwritten).
write.reasonNeeded: Say why first: this widens what one person can do.
write.placeRefused: That place may not be this default (its kind, or it is archived): choose another.
write.invalid: The server refused a value: check the card.
write.noCost: The value is a cost: changing it needs the right to see costs.
write.forbidden: Your role may not change the warehouse rules of this company.
write.forbiddenAll: Every company’s rules are changed only by a role over every company.
write.not_found: It was not found any more: read again.
write.signed_out: Your session ended: sign in again. Your changes are kept on this page.
write.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment and save again.
write.unavailable: The server could not be reached: your changes are kept, save again.
write.internal: Something went wrong saving this. Try again.

done.separationOff: Saved: one person may now do both steps of the rule switched off (the reason is kept).
done.postingLoosened: Saved: moves may now be dated further back (the reason is kept).
done.adjustLoosened: Saved: more adjustments now post without a yes (the reason is kept).
done.defaultsSome: {count} of {total} default locations saved; the others were refused and stay typed (read the card).

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.cancelled: Not saved: the code was not given. The rule stays as it was.

sentence.separation: Switching a separation rule off lets one person do both steps. Type a fresh 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
sentence.posting: Allowing moves dated further back widens what one person can do. Type a fresh 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
sentence.adjust: A higher adjustment value lets more adjustments post without a yes. Type a fresh 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

problem.wrong: That code is wrong or already used. Type the code your app shows now.
problem.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes and try again.
problem.unavailable: The code could not be checked now. Try again.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.openRule: Open the approval rule in Admin › Approvals, automation & AI
